### velocidad
```{r}

directorio <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/models/cc/mergem/biomass/"  
archivos <- list.files(path = directorio, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# 3. Función para procesar un solo archivo
procesar_archivo <- function(ruta_archivo) {
  # Leer el archivo delimitado por espacios/tabulaciones
  # Las columnas esperadas según tu ejemplo son: tiempo, x, y, simulation_id, biomass
  datos <- read.table(ruta_archivo, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, fill = TRUE)
  
  # Asignamos nombres a las columnas (ajusta según el número exacto de columnas)
  colnames(datos)[c(1, 4, 5)] <- c("time", "simulation", "biomass")
  
  # Limpiar el nombre de la simulación (quitar la extensión .cmd si es necesario)
  nombre_sim <- gsub("\\.cmd$", "", datos$simulation[1])
  
  # Obtener el primer y último valor de biomasa (asegurando tipo numérico)
  initial_mass <- as.numeric(head(na.omit(datos$biomass), 1))
  final_mass   <- as.numeric(tail(na.omit(datos$biomass), 1))
  
  # Si el tiempo total es necesario para calcular la tasa/velocidad:
  t_inicial <- head(datos$time, 1)
  t_final   <- tail(datos$time, 1)
  dt <- t_final - t_inicial
  
  # Calcular la diferencia absoluta o velocidad
  # Si es solo la diferencia: final_mass - initial_mass
  # Si es velocidad por unidad de tiempo: (final_mass - initial_mass) / dt
  velocity <- ifelse(dt > 0, (final_mass - initial_mass) / dt, final_mass - initial_mass)
  
  # Retornar una fila con los resultados
  tibble(
    simulation   = nombre_sim,
    initial_mass = initial_mass,
    final_mass   = final_mass,
    velocity     = velocity
  )
}

# 4. Aplicar la función a todos los archivos y combinar en un solo DataFrame
tabla_resultados <- map_df(archivos, procesar_archivo)

# 5. Visualizar la tabla resultante
print(tabla_resultados)

# 6. Guardar el resultado en un archivo CSV o TXT
write.csv(tabla_resultados, "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/models/cc/mergem/cambio_biomasa.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# 1. Cargar datos
data <- read.csv("/home/abigaylmontantearenas/Documents/proyecto_tesis/02_resultados/1708/1708_mm2_biomass/cambio_biomasas.csv")

# 2. Prefijos ordenados por longitud descendente
mis_prefijos <- c(
  "cc_na_cv_lb_mm", "cc_pk_cv_lb_mm", 
  "cc_na_kb_rt_na", "cc_na_kb_rt_lb", "cc_na_kb_rt_mm",
  "cc_pk_kb_rt_na", "cc_pk_kb_rt_lb", "cc_pk_kb_rt_mm",
  "cc_na_cv_na", "cc_na_cv_lb", "cc_na_cv_mm",
  "cc_pk_cv_na", "cc_pk_cv_lb", "cc_pk_cv_mm",
  "cc_na_gp_na", "cc_na_gp_lb", "cc_na_gp_mm",
  "cc_pk_gp_na", "cc_pk_gp_lb", "cc_pk_gp_mm"
)
mis_prefijos <- mis_prefijos[order(nchar(mis_prefijos), decreasing = TRUE)]

# 3. Asignar Condition, ID, Grupo (_cv_, _gp_, _kb_) y Color_Group
data_clean <- data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Condition = mis_prefijos[sapply(mis_prefijos, function(p) str_starts(simulation, p))][1],
    ID = str_remove(simulation, paste0("^", Condition, "_?")) %>% 
         str_remove("_biomass$")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Grupo = case_when(
      str_detect(Condition, "_cv_") ~ "CV",
      str_detect(Condition, "_gp_") ~ "GP",
      str_detect(Condition, "_kb_") ~ "KB",
      TRUE ~ "Otros"
    ),
    Color_Group = if_else(velocity == 0, "Cero (Sin crecimiento)", "Crecimiento (>0)")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Condition))

# 4. Directorio de salida
plots_dir <- "/home/abigaylmontantearenas/Documents/proyecto_tesis/02_resultados/1708/1708_mm2_biomass"
dir.create(plots_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# 5. Generar, mostrar y guardar gráficas por grupo
for (grp in c("CV", "GP", "KB")) {
  df_grp <- data_clean %>% filter(Grupo == grp)
  
  if (nrow(df_grp) == 0) next
  
  p <- ggplot(df_grp, aes(x = ID, y = velocity, color = Color_Group)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Cero (Sin crecimiento)" = "red", "Crecimiento (>0)" = "#2b5c8f")) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = pseudo_log_trans(base = 10)) +
    facet_wrap(~ Condition, scales = "free_x") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#e0e0e0"),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Velocidad de Crecimiento - Grupo:", grp),
      x = "ID",
      y = "Velocidad",
      color = "Estado"
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plots_dir, paste0("velocidades_grupo_", grp, ".png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 12,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

## Individual
### biomasas

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(fs)

indi_path     <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/biomass"
output_folder <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/graficas/cc/individuales/logxy"
dir_create(output_folder)

colores_bac <- c(
  baltitudinis_biomass    = "#455866",
  corynebacterium_biomass = "#436FA6",
  sarlettae_biomass       = "#5CBDB8",
  bthuringiensis_biomass  = "#5A8CB5",
  sshinii_biomass         = "#B3C5D3",
  batrophaeus_biomass     = "#7C4146",
  mluteus_biomass         = "#BC525D",
  binfantis_biomass       = "#D75454",
  pmegaterium_biomass     = "#C56E66",
  mindicus_biomass        = "#C79786"
)

name_bac <- c(
  baltitudinis_biomass    = "Bacillus altitudinis",
  corynebacterium_biomass = "Corynebacterium sp.",
  sarlettae_biomass       = "Staphylococcus arlettae",
  bthuringiensis_biomass  = "Bacillus thuringiensis",
  sshinii_biomass         = "Staphylococcus shinii",
  batrophaeus_biomass     = "Bacillus atrophaeus",
  mluteus_biomass         = "Micrococcus luteus",
  binfantis_biomass       = "Bacillus infantis",
  pmegaterium_biomass     = "Priestia megaterium",
  mindicus_biomass        = "Metabacillus indicus"
)

all_mass  <- list.files(path = indi_path, pattern = "biomass", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
all_mass  <- all_mass[!dir.exists(all_mass)]
data_indi <- data.frame()

# 1. Gráficas individuales
for (i in seq_along(all_mass)) {
  file_path <- all_mass[i]
  
  bac_key <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_path))
  op_id   <- basename(dirname(file_path))
  
  df <- read.table(file_path, header = FALSE, fill = TRUE, comment.char = "")
  if (ncol(df) < 5) next
  colnames(df)[1:5] <- c("time", "c2", "c3", "model_raw", "biomass")
  df <- df[1:min(400, nrow(df)), ]

  df <- df %>% 
    mutate(
      time     = as.numeric(time) * 0.1,
      biomass  = as.numeric(biomass),
      model_id = bac_key,
      sim_id   = op_id
    ) %>% 
    arrange(time)
  
  data_indi <- bind_rows(data_indi, df)
  
  color_individual <- ifelse(bac_key %in% names(colores_bac), colores_bac[bac_key], "#2b5c8f")
  nombre_limpio    <- ifelse(bac_key %in% names(name_bac), name_bac[bac_key], bac_key)

  p_single <- ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = biomass)) +
    geom_line(color = color_individual, linewidth = 1) +
    scale_y_log10() +
        scale_x_log10() +
    labs(
      subtitle = nombre_limpio,   
      x        = "Tiempo (h)",
      y        = "Biomasa (g)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(face = "italic", size = 11.5, color = "gray20"), #
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  print(p_single)
  
  out_name <- file.path(output_folder, paste0(bac_key, ".png"))
  ggsave(out_name, p_single, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}

# 2. Cálculo de métricas
metrics_summary <- data_indi %>%
  group_by(model_id) %>%
  arrange(time) %>%
  summarise(
    biomass_final   = last(biomass),
    auc             = sum(diff(time) * (head(biomass, -1) + tail(biomass, -1)) / 2),
    order_magnitude = ifelse(last(biomass) > 0, floor(log10(last(biomass))), NA_real_),
    .groups         = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(biomass_final)) %>%
  mutate(
    clean_name   = ifelse(model_id %in% names(name_bac), name_bac[model_id], model_id),
    label_legend = clean_name
  )
write.csv(metrics_summary, file.path(output_folder, "metricas_individual.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ordenado por biomasa de mayor a menor
data_indi <- data_indi %>%
  mutate(
    model_id = factor(
      model_id, 
      levels = metrics_summary$model_id,
      labels = metrics_summary$label_legend
    )
  )

colores_mapeados <- setNames(
  colores_bac[metrics_summary$model_id], 
  metrics_summary$label_legend
)

p_all <- ggplot(data_indi, aes(x = time, y = biomass, color = model_id, group = interaction(model_id, sim_id))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.85, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colores_mapeados) +
      scale_y_log10() +
          scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title    = "Crecimiento Comparativo de Cepas Individuales",
    x        = "Tiempo (h)",
    y        = "Biomasa (g)",
    color    = "Especie"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "right",
```

### biomasas
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(fs)
library(tidyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)

# Rutas
ruta_txt <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/biomass_tamanho_2/"
output_folder <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/graficas/cc/comunidades/logxy"
dir_create(output_folder)

colores_bac <- c(
  baltitudinis_biomass    = "#455866",
  corynebacterium_biomass = "#436FA6",
  sarlettae_biomass       = "#5CBDB8",
  bthuringiensis_biomass  = "#5A8CB5",
  sshinii_biomass         = "#B3C5D3",
  batrophaeus_biomass     = "#7C4146",
  mluteus_biomass         = "#BC525D",
  binfantis_biomass       = "#D75454",
  pmegaterium_biomass     = "#C56E66",
  mindicus_biomass        = "#C79786"
)
name_bac <- c(
  baltitudinis_biomass    = "Bacillus altitudinis",
  corynebacterium_biomass = "Corynebacterium sp.",
  sarlettae_biomass       = "Staphylococcus arlettae",
  bthuringiensis_biomass  = "Bacillus thuringiensis",
  sshinii_biomass         = "Staphylococcus shinii",
  batrophaeus_biomass     = "Bacillus atrophaeus",
  mluteus_biomass         = "Micrococcus luteus",
  binfantis_biomass       = "Bacillus infantis",
  pmegaterium_biomass     = "Priestia megaterium",
  mindicus_biomass        = "Metabacillus indicus"
)

keys_clean <- sub("_biomass$", "", names(colores_bac))
colores_bac_completos <- c(colores_bac, setNames(colores_bac, keys_clean))
name_bac_completos    <- c(name_bac, setNames(name_bac, keys_clean))

archivos <- list.files(ruta_txt, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================

all_community_metrics <- data.frame()

for (i in archivos) {
  com_name <- sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(i))
  
  df <- read_table(
    i,
    col_names = c("cicle", "x", "y", "id", "mass"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(cicle <= 5000) %>%
    mutate(
      species = sub("\\.cmd$", "", id),
      hours   = cicle * 0.1,
      mass    = as.numeric(mass)
    ) %>%
    arrange(hours)
  
  # Cálculo de métricas 
  metrics_com <- df_sub %>%
    group_by(species) %>%
    arrange(hours) %>%
    summarise(
      biomass_final   = last(mass),
      auc             = sum(diff(hours) * (head(mass, -1) + tail(mass, -1)) / 2),
      order_magnitude = ifelse(last(mass) > 0, floor(log10(last(mass))), NA_real_),
      .groups         = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(biomass_final)) %>%
    mutate(
      community    = com_name,
      clean_name   = ifelse(species %in% names(name_bac_completos), name_bac_completos[species], species),
      label_legend = clean_name
    )
  
  all_community_metrics <- bind_rows(all_community_metrics, metrics_com)
  
  # Reordenar para que la leyenda quede de mayor a menor
  df_sub <- df_sub %>%
    mutate(
      species = factor(
        species,
        levels = metrics_com$species,
        labels = metrics_com$label_legend
      )
    )
  
  # Vector con nombres exactos para la leyenda de las curvas
  colores_curvas <- setNames(
    colores_bac_completos[metrics_com$species],
    metrics_com$label_legend
  )
  
  # Gráfica de curvas por comunidad
  q_curves <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = hours, y = mass, color = species, linetype = species)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    #scale_x_log10() +
    geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colores_curvas) +
    labs(
      title    = com_name,
      x        = "Tiempo (h)",
      y        = "Biomasa (g)",
      color    = "Cepa",
      linetype = "Cepa"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.text      = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9.5)
    )
  
  print(q_curves)
  #ggsave(file.path(output_folder, paste0(com_name, ".png")), q_curves, width = 9, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
}

# Exportar tabla consolidada
#write.csv(all_community_metrics, file.path(output_folder, "metricas_todas_las_comunidades.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ==============================================================================
# GRÁFICAS  AUC 
# ==============================================================================

comunidades_unicas <- unique(all_community_metrics$community)

for (com_name in comunidades_unicas) {
  
  # Filtrar datos de la comunidad y ordenar por AUC
  metrics_auc <- all_community_metrics %>%
    filter(community == com_name) %>%
    arrange(desc(auc)) %>%
    mutate(species_ordered = factor(species, levels = rev(species)))
  
  # Gráfica de barras
  p_bar_auc <- ggplot(metrics_auc, aes(x = species_ordered, y = auc, fill = species)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colores_bac_completos) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = name_bac_completos) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.18))) +
    labs(
      title = paste("AUC -", com_name),
      x     = "Cepa",
      y     = "AUC"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "right",
      legend.text      = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9.5)
    )
  
  print(p_bar_auc)
  #out_path <- file.path(output_folder, paste0(com_name, "_auc.png"))
  #ggsave(out_path, p_bar_auc, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

aminoacidos <- c("cycle",
  "EX_ala__L_e", "EX_arg__L_e", "EX_asn__L_e", "EX_asp__L_e", "EX_cys__L_e",
  "EX_glu__L_e", "EX_gln__L_e", "EX_gly_e",    "EX_his__L_e", "EX_ile__L_e",
  "EX_leu__L_e", "EX_lys__L_e", "EX_met__L_e", "EX_phe__L_e", "EX_pro__L_e",
  "EX_ser__L_e", "EX_thr__L_e", "EX_trp__L_e", "EX_tyr__L_e", "EX_val__L_e"
)

keymets <- c("cycle",
  "EX_ac_e", "EX_for_e", "EX_gal_e", "EX_glyclt_e", "EX_lcts_e",
  "EX_meoh_e", "EX_pppn_e", "EX_co2_e", "EX_etoh_e", "EX_glc__D_e"
)

#ac_e = acetate, for_e = formate, gal_e = galactose, glyclt_e = glycolate, lcts_e = lactose, meoh_e = methanol, pppn_e = phenylpropanoate

ruta_flux <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/comunidades/fluxes/C11/"
archivos_flux <- list.files(ruta_flux, full.names = TRUE, pattern = "\\.txt$|\\.tsv$|\\.csv$")

for (flux in archivos_flux) {
  df <- read.delim(flux, sep = "\t")
  
  # Subset 
  df <- df[1:min(800, nrow(df)), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # Filtrar columnas con actividad (> 0) 
  cols_activas <- c(TRUE, colSums(abs(df[, -1, drop = FALSE])) > 0)
  df_clean <- df[, cols_activas, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Seleccionar cycle y metabolitos presentes
  df_filtro <- df_clean %>%
    select(any_of(aminoacidos))
  
  if (ncol(df_filtro) <= 1) {
    next
  }
  
  df_long <- df_filtro %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -cycle,
      names_to = "metabolito",
      values_to = "flux"
    )
  
  # ORDENAR COLORES DE GRAFICAS CON ETIQUETAS
  orden_mets <- sort(unique(df_long$metabolito))
  df_long$metabolito <- factor(df_long$metabolito, levels = orden_mets)
  
  # Gráfica
  m <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = cycle, y = flux, color = metabolito)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ metabolito, scales = "free_y") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 15,
        size = 6,
        linetype = 0
      )
    )) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Flujos -", basename(flux)),
      x = "Cycle",
      y = "Flux",
      color = "Metabolitos"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.0, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  print(m)
}
```

## Comparacion
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(fs)

#"D:/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/individual/fluxes/sshinii.tsv"
path_indi <- "D:/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/individual/biomass/"
path_com  <- "D:/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/comunidades/biomass/"
output_folder <- "D:/septiembre/graficas/cc/comparacion/"
dir_create(output_folder)


colores_bac <- c(
  baltitudinis   = "#455866",
  corynebacterium = "#436FA6",
  sarlettae       = "#5CBDB8",
  bthuringiensis  = "#5A8CB5",
  sshinii        = "#B3C5D3",
  batrophaeus   = "#7C4146",
  mluteus         = "#BC525D",
  binfantis      = "#D75454",
  pmegaterium    = "#C56E66",
  mindicus        = "#C79786"
)

name_bac <- c(
  baltitudinis    = "Bacillus altitudinis",
  corynebacterium = "Corynebacterium sp.",
  sarlettae     = "Staphylococcus arlettae",
  bthuringiensis  = "Bacillus thuringiensis",
  sshinii       = "Staphylococcus shinii",
  batrophaeus  = "Bacillus atrophaeus",
  mluteus        = "Micrococcus luteus",
  binfantis       = "Bacillus infantis",
  pmegaterium     = "Priestia megaterium",
  mindicus        = "Metabacillus indicus"
)


com_files <- list.files(path_com, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
com_files <- com_files[!dir.exists(com_files)]

all_com_data <- data.frame()

for (f in com_files) {
  # Extraer identificador de comunidad (ej. "com1_biomass.txt" -> "C1")
  com_raw <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  com_num <- str_extract(com_raw, "[0-9]+")
  com_id  <- ifelse(!is.na(com_num), paste0("C", com_num), com_raw)
  
  df_c <- read.table(f, header = FALSE, fill = TRUE, comment.char = "")
  if (ncol(df_c) < 5) next
  colnames(df_c)[1:5] <- c("time", "x", "y", "model", "biomass")
  
  # Limpiar nombre: "pseudomonas.cmd" -> "pseudomonas"
  df_c <- df_c %>%
    mutate(
      time     = as.numeric(time),
      biomass  = as.numeric(biomass),
      model_id = str_remove(model, "\\.cmd$"),
      Origen   = com_id
    )
  
  all_com_data <- bind_rows(all_com_data, df_c)
}


#  GRÁFICAS PARA COMPARAR

indi_files <- list.files(path_indi, full.names = TRUE)
indi_files <- indi_files[!dir.exists(indi_files)]

for (f_ind in indi_files) {
  
  raw_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f_ind))
  id_cepa  <- sub("_biomass$", "", raw_name)
  
  df_ind_raw <- read.table(f_ind, header = FALSE, fill = TRUE, comment.char = "")
  if (ncol(df_ind_raw) < 5) next
  colnames(df_ind_raw)[1:5] <- c("time", "c2", "c3", "model_raw", "biomass")
  
  df_ind <- df_ind_raw %>%
    mutate(
      time    = as.numeric(time),
      biomass = as.numeric(biomass)
    ) %>%
    arrange(time)
  
  # Biomasa final  individual
  bio_final_ind <- data.frame(
    Origen        = "Individual",
    biomass_final = last(df_ind$biomass)
  )
  
  # Filtrar bacteria en las comunidades
  df_com_match <- all_com_data %>%
    filter(model_id == id_cepa)
  
  
  # Biomasa final ordenada de mayor a menor
  bio_final_com <- df_com_match %>%
    group_by(Origen) %>%
    arrange(time) %>%
    summarise(biomass_final = last(biomass), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(biomass_final))
  
  data_barras <- bind_rows(bio_final_ind, bio_final_com) %>%
    mutate(
      order_mag = ifelse(biomass_final > 0, floor(log10(biomass_final)), NA_real_),
      Origen    = factor(Origen, levels = c("Individual", bio_final_com$Origen))
    )
  
  color_actual  <- ifelse(id_cepa %in% names(colores_bac), colores_bac[id_cepa], "#2b5c8f")
  nombre_actual <- ifelse(id_cepa %in% names(name_bac), name_bac[id_cepa], id_cepa)
  
  # gráfica de barras
  p_comp <- ggplot(data_barras, aes(x = Origen, y = biomass_final)) +
    geom_col(fill = color_actual, color = "black", width = 0.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(
      title    = nombre_actual,
      x        = "Condición",
      y        = "Biomasa Final (g)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 13),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "bold")
    )
  
  print(p_comp)
  out_file <- file.path(output_folder, paste0("comp_biomasa_", id_cepa, ".png"))
  ggsave(out_file, p_comp, width = 7.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
}
```

````{r}
library(ggplot2)
````

```{r}
# 1. Rutas
ruta_txt <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/comunidades/biomass/"

# 2. Diccionarios de colores y nombres
colores_bac <- c(
  baltitudinis_biomass    = "#455866",
  corynebacterium_biomass = "#436FA6",
  sarlettae_biomass       = "#5CBDB8",
  bthuringiensis_biomass  = "#5A8CB5",
  sshinii_biomass         = "#B3C5D3",
  batrophaeus_biomass     = "#7C4146",
  mluteus_biomass         = "#BC525D",
  binfantis_biomass       = "#D75454",
  pmegaterium_biomass     = "#C56E66",
  mindicus_biomass        = "#C79786"
)

name_bac <- c(
  baltitudinis_biomass    = "Bacillus altitudinis",
  corynebacterium_biomass = "Corynebacterium sp.",
  sarlettae_biomass       = "Staphylococcus arlettae",
  bthuringiensis_biomass  = "Bacillus thuringiensis",
  sshinii_biomass         = "Staphylococcus shinii",
  batrophaeus_biomass     = "Bacillus atrophaeus",
  mluteus_biomass         = "Micrococcus luteus",
  binfantis_biomass       = "Bacillus infantis",
  pmegaterium_biomass     = "Priestia megaterium",
  mindicus_biomass        = "Metabacillus indicus"
)

keys_clean <- sub("_biomass$", "", names(colores_bac))
colores_bac_completos <- c(colores_bac, setNames(colores_bac, keys_clean))
name_bac_completos    <- c(name_bac, setNames(name_bac, keys_clean))

# Paleta asignada a los nombres legibles

colores_plot <- colores_plot[!duplicated(names(colores_plot))]

# 3. Lectura y consolidación de todos los archivos
archivos <- list.files(ruta_txt, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

all_data <- list()

for (i in archivos) {
  com_name <- sub("\\.txt$", "", basename(i))
  
  df <- read_table(
    i,
    col_names = c("cicle", "x", "y", "id", "mass"),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(cicle <= 5000) %>%
    mutate(
      species       = sub("\\.cmd$", "", id),
      hours         = cicle * 0.1,
      mass          = as.numeric(mass),
      community     = com_name,
      species_clean = ifelse(species %in% names(name_bac_completos), name_bac_completos[species], species)
    ) %>%
    arrange(hours)
  
  all_data[[com_name]] <- df_sub
}

# Unir todo el set de datos
df_total <- bind_rows(all_data)

# 4. Imprimir la gráfica única
print(

    scale_x_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(values = colores_plot) +

      x        = "Tiempo (h)",
      y        = "Biomasa (g)",

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.text      = element_text(face = "italic", size = 9)
    )
)
```

### Frecuencia relativa
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(fs)
library(stringr)

ruta_comunidades <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/comunidades/biomass"
ruta_individual  <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/individual/biomass"
output_folder    <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/graficas/cc/abundancia"
dir_create(output_folder)

colores_bac <- c(
  baltitudinis_biomass    = "#455866",
  corynebacterium_biomass = "#436FA6",
  sarlettae_biomass       = "#5CBDB8",
  bthuringiensis_biomass  = "#5A8CB5",
  sshinii_biomass         = "#B3C5D3",
  batrophaeus_biomass     = "#7C4146",
  mluteus_biomass         = "#BC525D",
  binfantis_biomass       = "#D75454",
  pmegaterium_biomass     = "#C56E66",
  mindicus_biomass        = "#C79786"
)

name_bac <- c(
  baltitudinis_biomass    = "Bacillus altitudinis",
  corynebacterium_biomass = "Corynebacterium sp.",
  sarlettae_biomass       = "Staphylococcus arlettae",
  bthuringiensis_biomass  = "Bacillus thuringiensis",
  sshinii_biomass         = "Staphylococcus shinii",
  batrophaeus_biomass     = "Bacillus atrophaeus",
  mluteus_biomass         = "Micrococcus luteus",
  binfantis_biomass       = "Bacillus infantis",
  pmegaterium_biomass     = "Priestia megaterium",
  mindicus_biomass        = "Metabacillus indicus"
)

keys_clean <- sub("_biomass$", "", names(colores_bac))
colores_bac_completos <- c(colores_bac, setNames(colores_bac, keys_clean))
name_bac_completos    <- c(name_bac, setNames(name_bac, keys_clean))

archivos_com <- list.files(ruta_comunidades, pattern = "\\.txt$", ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

all_data <- map_dfr(archivos_com, function(file_path) {
  # Extraer solo C1, C2, etc., removiendo _biomass y la extensión
  com_id <- sub("\\.[^.]+$", "", basename(file_path))
  com_id <- sub("_biomass$", "", com_id, ignore.case = TRUE)
  com_id <- sub("^com(unidad)?_?", "C", com_id, ignore.case = TRUE)
  
  df <- read_table(
    file_path,
    col_names = c("cicle", "x", "y", "model", "biomass"),
    col_types = cols(
      cicle   = col_double(),
      x       = col_double(),
      y       = col_double(),
      model   = col_character(),
      biomass = col_double()
    ),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      model_id   = sub("\\.cmd$", "", model),
      clean_name = ifelse(model_id %in% names(name_bac_completos), name_bac_completos[model_id], model_id),
      hours      = cicle * 0.1,
      com        = com_id
    ) %>%
    filter(model_id %in% names(colores_bac_completos))
})

# Tiempos de interés cada 20 horas (200 ciclos)
cicles_keep <- seq(0, 2000, by = 200)

rel_time <- all_data %>%
  filter(cicle %in% cicles_keep) %>%
  group_by(com, cicle, hours, clean_name) %>%
  summarise(biomass = sum(biomass), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(com, cicle) %>%
  mutate(rel_abund = biomass / sum(biomass)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Ordenar las comunidades de forma numérica natural (C1, C2, ..., C10, C11...)
com_numeros <- as.numeric(regmatches(rel_time$com, regexpr("[0-9]+", rel_time$com)))
if (!all(is.na(com_numeros))) {
  orden_coms <- unique(rel_time$com[order(com_numeros)])
  rel_time$com <- factor(rel_time$com, levels = orden_coms)
}

colores_plot <- setNames(colores_bac_completos, name_bac_completos)
colores_plot <- colores_plot[!duplicated(names(colores_plot))]

for (com_i in levels(rel_time$com)) {
  df_sub <- rel_time %>% filter(com == com_i)
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) next
  
  p_com <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = factor(hours), y = rel_abund, fill = clean_name)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colores_plot, name = "Cepa") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = c(0, 0), 
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), 
      labels = scales::percent
    ) +
    labs(
      title = com_i,
      x     = "Tiempo (h)",
      y     = "Abundancia Relativa"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title         = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 12, color = "black"),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title       = element_text(size = 15),
      legend.text        = element_text(face = "italic", size = 12)
    )
  
  print(p_com)
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_folder, paste0("abundancia_relativa_", com_i, ".png")),
    plot     = p_com,
    width    = 9,
    height   = 6,
    dpi      = 300
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

graphics.off()

ruta_txt <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/comunidades/fluxes"
output   <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/graficas/cc/binfantis"

if (!dir.exists(output)) {
  dir.create(output, recursive = TRUE)
}

archivos <- list.files(
  path = ruta_txt,
  pattern = "_binfantis_.*\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE
)

# Listas para acumular la presencia de metabolitos de todas las comunidades
registro_consumo    <- list()
registro_produccion <- list()

for (ruta in archivos) {
  flux_file_m <- read.delim(ruta, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)
  if (nrow(flux_file_m) == 0) next
  
  flux_file_m <- flux_file_m[1:min(1000, nrow(flux_file_m)), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # 1. Conservar columnas activas
  cols_activas <- c(TRUE, colSums(abs(flux_file_m[, -1, drop = FALSE]), na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
  df_clean_m <- flux_file_m[, cols_activas, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Tiempo en horas (ciclo * 0.1)
  df_clean_m[, 1] <- df_clean_m[, 1] * 0.1
  colnames(df_clean_m)[1] <- "tiempo"
  
  nombre_archivo <- sub("\\.tsv$", "", basename(ruta))
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. CONSUMO (< 0)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  cols_c <- c(TRUE, vapply(df_clean_m[, -1, drop = FALSE], function(x) any(x < 0, na.rm = TRUE), logical(1)))
  consumo <- df_clean_m[, cols_c, drop = FALSE]
  
  if (ncol(consumo) > 1) {
    mets_c <- colnames(consumo)[-1]
    
    # Guardar en la lista global para el CSV final
    registro_consumo[[nombre_archivo]] <- data.frame(
      comunidad  = nombre_archivo,
      metabolito = mets_c,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    df_long_c <- consumo %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -tiempo, names_to = "metabolito", values_to = "flujo")
    
    # Filtrar dinamicas apreciables
    df_long_c <- df_long_c %>%
      group_by(metabolito) %>%
      filter((max(flujo, na.rm = TRUE) - min(flujo, na.rm = TRUE)) > 1e-5) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    if (nrow(df_long_c) > 0) {
      orden_mets_c <- sort(unique(df_long_c$metabolito))
      df_long_c$metabolito <- factor(df_long_c$metabolito, levels = orden_mets_c)
      
      m_c <- ggplot(df_long_c, aes(x = tiempo, y = flujo, color = metabolito)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
        geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
        facet_wrap(~ metabolito, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
        labs(
          title = paste("Consumo -", nombre_archivo),
          x = "Tiempo (h)",
          y = "Flujo"
        ) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          # Conservar etiquetas en cada recuadro
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey70"),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")
        )
      
      filas_c <- ceiling(length(unique(df_long_c$metabolito)) / 5)
      alto_c  <- max(6, filas_c * 2.2)
      
      ggsave(
        filename = file.path(output, paste0("consumo_", nombre_archivo, ".png")),
        plot = m_c, width = 13, height = alto_c, dpi = 300
      )
    }
  }
  
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. PRODUCCIÓN (> 0)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------
  cols_p <- c(TRUE, vapply(df_clean_m[, -1, drop = FALSE], function(x) any(x > 0, na.rm = TRUE), logical(1)))
  produccion <- df_clean_m[, cols_p, drop = FALSE]
  
  if (ncol(produccion) > 1) {
    mets_p <- colnames(produccion)[-1]
    
    # Guardar en la lista global para el CSV final
    registro_produccion[[nombre_archivo]] <- data.frame(
      comunidad  = nombre_archivo,
      metabolito = mets_p,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    df_long_p <- produccion %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -tiempo, names_to = "metabolito", values_to = "flujo")
    
    # Filtrar dinamicas apreciables
    df_long_p <- df_long_p %>%
      group_by(metabolito) %>%
      filter((max(flujo, na.rm = TRUE) - min(flujo, na.rm = TRUE)) > 1e-5) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    if (nrow(df_long_p) > 0) {
      orden_mets_p <- sort(unique(df_long_p$metabolito))
      df_long_p$metabolito <- factor(df_long_p$metabolito, levels = orden_mets_p)
      
      m_p <- ggplot(df_long_p, aes(x = tiempo, y = flujo, color = metabolito)) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
        geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
        facet_wrap(~ metabolito, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
        labs(
          title = paste("Producción -", nombre_archivo),
          x = "Tiempo (h)",
          y = "Flujo"
        ) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          # Conservar etiquetas en cada recuadro
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "grey70"),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
          panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")
        )
      
      filas_p <- ceiling(length(unique(df_long_p$metabolito)) / 5)
      alto_p  <- max(6, filas_p * 2.2)
      
      ggsave(
        filename = file.path(output, paste0("produccion_", nombre_archivo, ".png")),
        plot = m_p, width = 13, height = alto_p, dpi = 300
      )
    }
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. GUARDAR LOS 2 ARCHIVOS CSV GLOBALES
# -------------------------------------------------------------
tabla_consumo_total <- bind_rows(registro_consumo)
tabla_produccion_total <- bind_rows(registro_produccion)

write.csv(
  tabla_consumo_total,
  file = file.path(output, "metabolitos_consumo_infidivual.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  tabla_produccion_total,
  file = file.path(output, "metabolitos_produccion_individual.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(fs)


ruta_txt        <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/comunidades/biomass"
ruta_individual <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/bacterias/cc/vk1/individual/biomass"
output_folder   <- "/media/abigaylmontantearenas/KINGSTON/septiembre/graficas/cc"
dir_create(output_folder)

cepas_info <- tibble::tribble(
  ~cepa,                     ~clave,           ~color,
  "Bacillus altitudinis",    "baltitudinis",    "#455866",
  "Corynebacterium sp.",     "corynebacterium", "#436FA6",
  "Bacillus thuringiensis",  "bthuringiensis",  "#5A8CB5",
  "Staphylococcus arlettae", "sarlettae",       "#5CBDB8",
  "Bacillus atrophaeus",     "batrophaeus",     "#7C4146",
  "Micrococcus luteus",      "mluteus",         "#BC525D",
  "Bacillus infantis",       "binfantis",       "#D75454",
  "Priestia megaterium",     "pmegaterium",     "#C56E66",
  "Metabacillus indicus",    "mindicus",        "#C79786",
  "Staphylococcus shinii",   "sshinii",         "#B3C5D3"
)

ciclo_maximo <- 2000

archivos_com <- list.files(ruta_txt, pattern = "\\.txt$", ignore.case = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

df_todas_com <- map_dfr(archivos_com, function(f) {
  com_name <- sub("\\.[^.]+$", "", basename(f))
  df <- read_table(
    f,
    col_names = c("cicle", "x", "y", "id", "mass"),
    col_types = cols(cicle = col_double(), x = col_double(), y = col_double(), id = col_character(), mass = col_double()),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      hours     = cicle * 0.1,
      mass      = as.numeric(mass),
      community = com_name
    )
}) %>%
  filter(mass > 0, cicle <= ciclo_maximo)

df_com_plot <- map_dfr(1:nrow(cepas_info), function(i) {
  c_nombre <- cepas_info$cepa[i]
  c_clave  <- cepas_info$clave[i]
  
  df_todas_com %>%
    filter(str_detect(id, c_clave)) %>%
    mutate(
      cepa      = c_nombre,
      condicion = "Comunidad"
    )
})


archivos_ind <- list.files(ruta_individual, pattern = "\\.txt$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

df_ind_plot <- map_dfr(1:nrow(cepas_info), function(i) {
  c_nombre <- cepas_info$cepa[i]
  c_clave  <- cepas_info$clave[i]
  
  arch_ind <- archivos_ind[str_detect(tolower(archivos_ind), tolower(c_clave))]
  if (length(arch_ind) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  read_table(
    arch_ind[1],
    col_names = c("cicle", "x", "y", "id", "mass"),
    col_types = cols(cicle = col_double(), x = col_double(), y = col_double(), id = col_character(), mass = col_double()),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
    group_by(cicle) %>%
    summarise(mass = sum(mass), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      hours     = cicle * 0.1,
      cepa      = c_nombre,
      condicion = "Aislado"
    ) %>%
    filter(mass > 0, cicle <= ciclo_maximo)
})

# Fijar orden exacto de las 10 cepas
niveles_cepas <- cepas_info$cepa
df_com_plot$cepa <- factor(df_com_plot$cepa, levels = niveles_cepas)
df_ind_plot$cepa <- factor(df_ind_plot$cepa, levels = niveles_cepas)

colores_cepas <- setNames(cepas_info$color, cepas_info$cepa)

p_panel <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = df_com_plot,
    aes(x = hours, y = mass, group = community, color = cepa, linetype = condicion),
    alpha = 0.45,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = df_ind_plot,
    aes(x = hours, y = mass, color = cepa, linetype = condicion),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colores_cepas, guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name   = NULL,
    values = c("Aislado" = "dashed", "Comunidad" = "solid")
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ cepa, nrow = 2, ncol = 5, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(
    x = "Tiempo (h)",
    y = expression(log[10] * "(Biomasa [g])")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold.italic", size = 9.5),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    axis.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.spacing.x    = unit(0.05, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.y    = unit(0.05, "lines"),
    plot.margin        = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.title       = element_blank(),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.key.width   = unit(2, "cm")
  )

print(p_panel)


salida_final <- file.path(output_folder, "panel_dinamicas_sin_espacios.png")

ggsave(
  filename = salida_final,
  plot     = p_panel,
  width    = 20,
  height   = 8.5,
  dpi      = 300
)
```
